comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is an ordering system for food trucks?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and the collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till system or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with the places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the collection times your kitchen can really handle. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till system and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay on collection at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
